packageRules.description: Everything else shares one PR, so a quiet week is a single review.

The stealth browser stack gets its own PR. invisible-playwright carries the patched Firefox and is pinned exactly for that reason, so a bump changes how solving behaves while the build stays green. Run /live-check before merging one. This rule sits after the group above on purpose: for these packages the later rule wins.
Never auto-merge: nothing gates a PR on a real solve, and a bad browser or driver bump breaks solving without failing the build.
